Hero.title: More order in the workshop and easier booking for small service teams.
Hero.description: AutoSlot is built for independent workshops that want one clear flow from visit and estimate to repair order and invoice.
Hero.visualDescription: From the first customer touchpoint to the final invoice, without disconnected steps.

Problem.title: If your workshop still runs on scattered notes and calls, this will feel familiar.
Problem.description: Small garages lose time every day when there is no clear process between intake, approval and invoicing.
Problem.painPointAppointments: Chaotic appointments and walk-ins throughout the day.
Problem.painPointStatus: Unclear repair status across the team.
Problem.painPointCommunication: Notes, calls and messages spread across different channels.
Problem.painPointEstimates: No clear estimate step before repair approval.
Problem.painPointAdmin: Too much admin overhead before invoicing.

SolutionFlow.title: A clear flow from visit to final invoice.
SolutionFlow.description: AutoSlot structures daily operations in 4 connected steps, so the team always knows what comes next.
SolutionFlow.visitDescription: Capture customer intake and repair context at the first touchpoint.
SolutionFlow.estimateDescription: Prepare and confirm the estimate before starting repair work.
SolutionFlow.workOrderDescription: Turn approval into clear execution tasks for the workshop team.
SolutionFlow.invoiceDescription: Close the process with invoicing and final job status.

Benefits.title: Practical benefits for everyday workshop operations.
Benefits.description: AutoSlot keeps things simple: it organizes the process your team already runs with less friction between front desk, technicians and customers.

lessChaos.title: Less schedule chaos
lessChaos.description: Appointments and walk-ins become easier to manage across the day.

fasterFlow.title: Faster path from visit to invoice
fasterFlow.description: Jobs move through each stage without jumping between disconnected tools.

teamCommunication.title: Better team communication
teamCommunication.description: Each order keeps shared context, so less time is spent chasing updates.

repairStatus.title: Clearer repair status
repairStatus.description: Everyone can see progress at a glance, without extra back-and-forth.

lessAdmin.title: Less admin overhead
lessAdmin.description: Reduce repetitive paperwork before finalizing and invoicing work.

clientHandling.title: Simpler customer handling
clientHandling.description: Respond faster and keep customer communication more consistent.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions before contact.
FAQ.description: Short and practical answers to help workshop owners decide whether AutoSlot fits this stage.

item1.question: Who is AutoSlot built for?
item1.answer: Mainly independent small and mid-sized workshops that want a clearer day-to-day workflow.

item2.question: Can customers book online?
item2.answer: Yes. Online booking is part of the roadmap, and in pilot we validate the setup with each workshop.

item3.question: Can I prepare an estimate before repair starts?
item3.answer: Yes. Estimate before repair is a core step in the workflow.

item4.question: What about invoicing and tax-compliance direction?
item4.answer: AutoSlot supports the invoicing workflow. Tax-compliance details are refined per market during onboarding.

item5.question: What are the pricing basics?
item5.answer: Current entry point is from 49 EUR for up to 5 bays / workstations, with pilot scope aligned during demo.

item6.question: Does AutoSlot support multiple languages?
item6.answer: Yes. Current landing and pilot communication support Spanish, Polish and English.

item7.question: Is this final product stage or early access?
item7.answer: It is early access with first partner garages. Feedback from pilot rollouts shapes priorities.
